Built Different

Everything you need from a modern blockchain — with sustainability at its core.

🌿

Eco-Friendly by Design

DPoS consensus uses 99% less energy than Proof of Work. Every transaction contributes to carbon offset projects and reforestation.

💱

Native AMM DEX

Decentralized exchange built directly into the chain. Swap VRS, CARBON, ECO, TREE, GREEN and REDD tokens with 0.3% fees.

🔑

DPoS Consensus

27 registered validators with delegated voting. 5-second block times with single-block finality. Green validator scoring rewards renewable energy.

📱

Wallet Compatible

Ethereum JSON-RPC with Keccak256 address derivation. Works with Trust Wallet, MetaMask, and any EVM-compatible wallet. Chain ID 909.

📜

Smart Contracts

Stack-based virtual machine for deploying and executing smart contracts. Deploy custom logic for DeFi, governance, and more.

💾

Persistent State

All blocks, balances, DEX pools, and contracts are saved to disk every 30 seconds. The chain survives any restart without data loss.

Real Environmental Impact

Verdis tracks and verifies real-world environmental data on-chain. Every transaction helps fund a greener planet.
